Build strength, improve muscle tone, and feel stronger with this full body dumbbell workout for women over 50! This at-home strength training workout targets your major muscle groups to help improve strength, support healthy aging, and maintain mobility and independence.
Grab your dumbbells and join me for a full body workout designed to work your arms, shoulders, back, chest, legs, and core. Choose 1, 2 or 3 sets depending on your level or time available.
